snippet.title: Zack D Films vs The Original Version (Part 3)
snippet.description:
Zack D Films’ retellings vs other footage and images, side by side. This video covers nine stories, from a dog whose headbutt exposed her disease to a man who traded a paperclip for a house.

Extra context in this video:

The paperclip story is Kyle MacDonald’s 2006 “One Red Paperclip” project, in which he made a series of online trades that ended with a house in Kipling, Saskatchewan.
The goalkeeper story is Roberto Rojas, who faked an injury from a firework thrown on the pitch during Chile’s 1989 World Cup qualifier against Brazil at the Maracanã.
The saw that stops for fingers is SawStop, a table saw safety system invented by Steve Gass.

How I made it: Edited in CapCut (Mobile). Each story has scenes selected and aligned side by side, with on-screen text explaining what’s happening.

Credits: Zack D Films. Other clips and images are from various sources found online. All footage, music, photos and graphics belong to their respective owners. If you own something shown here and want it credited or removed, contact me.

Time stamps

0:00 - The dog headbutt that exposed her disease
0:32 - The goalkeeper who faked a firework injury
1:21 - Monkey head transplant
1:52 - He got beat up for attacking a seal
2:24 - How this expensive wood is made
2:55 - Saw that stops for fingers
3:25 - The filipino clam that lives inside wood
3:52 - He traded a paperclip for a house
4:49 - How a goldfish gets a forhead trim

snippet.title: Zack D Films vs The Original Version (Part 4)
snippet.description:
Zack D Films' retellings vs. other footage and images, side by side. This video covers six stories, from an orangutan who nearly drowned getting food to a penguin who bought his own fish.

Time Stamps
0:00 - Orangutan nearly drowns getting food
0:58 - How foil surfing works
1:44 - This fencer let his opponent hit him
2:46 - They nuked this well
3:44 - The penguin who bought his own fish
4:29 - How a ladder trap works

Extra context in this video:

The nuked well: In 1966, Soviet engineers detonated a nuclear device underground to seal a burning gas well at Urta-Bulak in Uzbekistan.
Foil surfing: The board has a hydrofoil, an underwater wing that lifts it above the water as it gains speed, which cuts drag.

How I made it: Edited in CapCut (Mobile). I pause Zack D Films' video at key moments to add my own voiceover explaining what's happening, then continue. Each story has scenes selected and aligned side by side with other footage, with on-screen text for context.
